# @tiaforge-ui/patina

> An expressive surface layer over temper, for sinter apps: materials (glass, gradient, mesh, grain), brand-tinted elevation and glow, display type with font pairings, hero and bento layouts, seeded gradient avatars. Fixed `data-*` vocabulary (vocab.json, checked by `patina check`), CSS in `@layer pt.*` after temper's layers, every colour from temper's `--tm-hue`/`--tm-chroma` in OKLCH, text AA in light and dark mode. No classes, no app CSS, no runtime script.

Setup: `import '@tiaforge-ui/patina/patina.css'` after temper's CSS; `sinter({ libraries: ['@tiaforge-ui/patina'] })` for `<pt-avatar>`; `patina()` from `@tiaforge-ui/patina/vite` beside `temper()` (runs patina check in the build); `export * as patina from '@tiaforge-ui/patina'` in src/sinter.helpers.ts for `patina.seed(name)` / `patina.initials(name)`. A pairing's face: `import '@fontsource-variable/fraunces'` (editorial) or `'@fontsource-variable/bricolage-grotesque'` (grotesk), and `fonts: { preload: ['Fraunces Variable'] }` in sinter's config for the first frame.

Rules: temper's still apply (semantic HTML, the parent owns space: data-layout/data-gap/data-pad, sizes xs–xl, no margins). patina adds looks, never layout of its own except data-hero and data-bento. Use exactly the values below; `null` (not false) to leave one out in data-sn-attr.

| Attribute | Values | Use |
|---|---|---|
| `data-surface` | glass, gradient, mesh | Background as a material. mesh: page backgrounds, mastheads; glass: cards, toolbars, tiles over a surface; gradient: bands, banners. Panels (not body/main) get temper's large radius. |
| `data-grain` | (boolean) | Film grain over the background; combine with data-surface. CSP needs `img-src data:`. |
| `data-elevation` | raised, floating | Brand-tinted shadow. raised: cards (lifts on hover when it holds data-stretch); floating: dialogs, a hero's card. |
| `data-halo` | (boolean) | Accent glow: the main button of a hero, a profile avatar. Decorative. |
| `data-display` | hero, xl, lg | Display type on h1–h4, p, span, strong, a. hero: one per landing page; xl: page title; lg: section title, big letters, dialog title. |
| `data-ink` | gradient | Gradient text, with data-display or data-figure. |
| `data-figure` | (boolean) | Big tabular number in a stat tile (dd, data, strong, span, p); label it with temper's data-caption. |
| `data-hero` | (boolean) | Centered column, balanced text, padding that grows with the screen (data-pad fixes it, e.g. a band in a dialog). |
| `data-bento` | (boolean) | Only with `data-layout="grid"`: rows of `--pt-row` (7rem), dense flow; column width is temper's `--tm-min`. |
| `data-span` | wide, tall, large, full | On a direct child of data-bento; applies from a 32rem wide grid. |
| `data-pairing` | editorial, grotesk | On html, body or main: the display face for data-display/data-figure. Body text stays --tm-font-sans. |
| `data-seed` | 0–11 | Gradient fill + ink from 12 hues around the brand hue; on temper's data-avatar or a small tile. `patina.seed(name)` picks one. |

Component: `<pt-avatar data-sn-with="{ name, src?, size?: 'sm' | 'md' | 'lg' | 'xl', halo? }">` — temper's avatar, the photo or two initials on the name's seed; aria-hidden (the name is beside it).

Recipes:
- Landing/sign-in: `<body data-surface="mesh" data-grain data-pairing="editorial">`, `<div data-hero>` with `h1 data-display="hero" data-ink="gradient"`, `p data-muted`, and the form in `article data-surface="glass" data-elevation="floating" data-pad="lg"` (narrow it with `<div data-layout="center" style="--tm-measure: 24rem">`); features in `ul data-layout="grid" data-bento data-gap="md" style="--tm-min: 12rem"` of `li data-surface="glass" data-pad="lg"`, an icon in `span data-avatar data-seed="4"`.
- Page masthead: `header data-surface="mesh" data-grain data-layout="row" data-justify="between" data-pad="lg"` with `h1 data-display="xl" data-ink="gradient"` and a `dl data-layout="grid" data-bento` of glass tiles (`dt data-caption`, `dd data-figure`).
- Sticky toolbar: `data-surface="glass" data-sticky="top" data-pad="xs"` (temper's data-sticky; do not give it position in app CSS).
- Cards: `article data-elevation="raised"`; a profile band: `div data-surface="gradient" data-grain data-hero data-pad="lg"` with `<pt-avatar … size: 'xl', halo: true>`.

Tokens to set: --pt-font-display, --pt-display-weight, --pt-display-tracking, --pt-blur, --pt-row. Derived (read only): --pt-tint-1, --pt-tint-2, --pt-tint-3, --pt-glass, --pt-ink-1, --pt-ink-2, --pt-glow, --pt-shadow-raised, --pt-shadow-floating. Rebrand with temper's --tm-hue/--tm-chroma only (AA verified for chroma 0.04–0.22).

Check: `npx patina check <paths>` (PT101 bad value, PT102 boolean with a value, PT104 typo, PT107 missing companion, PT108 wrong element, PT109 span outside bento, PT110 patina.css not imported, PT201–203 tokens). temper's rules stay with temper check.

Anti-patterns: a class or app CSS for a glass card (use data-surface="glass"); `data-layout="bento"` (temper owns data-layout: `data-layout="grid" data-bento`); hard-coded gradient colours (they ignore the brand and dark mode); data-ink on body text (display sizes only); position in app CSS on a data-sticky element.
